QuestInfo.name: [Advice from General Maestro] Brazen Bravery
QuestInfo.0: You'll need courage to pass the M-Forcer Action Exam! Talk to General Maestro for advice on how to get more courage.
QuestInfo.1: General Maestro's advice on how to get more courage? Eliminate monsters! He says to hunt monsters #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you.#k
QuestInfo.2: You're received Brazen Bravery from General Mastro!

0.0: You here for the M-Forcer Action Exam? Perfect timing, I was just looking for someone to-- Zzzzzzzz. *snort* What?! Right. You'll need three things to become an M-Forcer: courage, will, and faith! And you'll need them in abundance!
0.1: In fact, all you have to do is-- Zzzzzzz. *snort* What?! Right. You need #bcourage, will, and faith,#k and tons of it! Prove to me you have Brazen Bravery. That means you'll risk your neck to save others! I do it all the ti-- Zzzzz.

yes.0: Defeat monsters to prove your courage! Remember, #bonly monsters that are between 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you count!#k Now get out there and kick some as-- Zzzzzz.

1.0: I'M NOT SLEEPING! Oh, it's you. You've eliminated a satisfactory number of monsters. I wish I'd had you at my side when I founded the Omega Sector to protect civilians from the alien threat.

yes.0: M-Forcers don't fight for fight for fame or glory! We fight to protect people from aliens. That's what Brazen Bravery is all about!
